facts.fact: Kayla 在棺材里醒来，听到 Brawley 的声音才安下心，并装成昏迷
facts.anchor: Dirt drops on me as someone removes the coffin’s lid, and I panic, feigning unconsciousness. But when I hear Brawley, his voice calms me a little.

facts.fact: Brawley 与 Ares 合力把 Kayla 从坑里拖出放在地上
facts.anchor: Then between the two of them they drag me out of the hole and lie me on the ground nearby.

facts.fact: Kayla 问 Vero 在哪，所有人都别开眼、无人回答，Brawley 只说他需要一分钟
facts.anchor: I look around again. “Where’s Vero?” They all look away, even Clay, and no one answers me.

facts.fact: Clay 判定是 Aaron 干的；他雇的私家侦探来电说 Aaron 最后出现在她的阁楼附近并发来照片
facts.anchor: “The PI I hired just called and told me he was last seen near your loft. He forwarded a photo.”

facts.fact: Clay 命 Brawley 去叫 Banks（不是医生但有医疗训练，否则就得送医院），Kayla 拒绝医院、同意让 Banks 来；Banks 检查后确认她没脑震荡、瞳孔与心率正常并给了药
facts.anchor: “Banks it is,” I tell them. I’m not going to the hospital.

facts.fact: Brawley 查手机 app 发现 Vero 的定位在玉米地，Clay 判断他以为是 Cave 干的；Brawley 与 Clay 出发去找，Brawley 向 Kayla 保证一定把他带回来
Kayla 向 Ares 承认自己需要他，关系从被保护转为彼此需要
facts.anchor: About how much I needed you in that moment. I might talk a big game about not being able to be controlled again or manipulated, but you have weaseled your way in and are now someone I need.

facts.fact: Ares 把 Kayla 抱上自己房间、替她洗澡、给她换上自己的衬衫并安置在自己的床上
facts.anchor: Ares walks him out, and when he comes back, he scoops me up in his arms, even though I protest.
